summary: spectral-core 3.0.12 exfiltrates environment and local files via binding.gyp at install
details: The package's binding.gyp declares a single target of type "none" with an inline action that node-gyp evaluates at install time. The action runs a Node one-liner that uses child_process.execSync to enumerate local filesystem paths (including /tmp/scent-payloads/ and recursive grep for HTB{ markers under /tmp/), reads local files such as /opt/ph/sitecustomize.py and /tmp/scent-trail.jsonl, dumps all of process.env, and POSTs the collected data to https://webhook.site/f604623f-fc78-4447-9225-6772f7f12cb1. The tarball ships no C/C++ sources and the main module is a trivial stub, so binding.gyp exists solely as an install-time execution and exfiltration vector rather than to build a native addon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
